text:
In July 2017 our record concentrated on two instruments of appropriation. On 2017-07-14, 135 of us said "national defense authorization act"; 91 said "the national defense"; 90 said "the national defense authorization act"; 87 said "national defense authorization act ndaa." That phrase first entered the record 2013-01-03, first said by M001166. Fifty-seven of us said "for fiscal year," a phrase first dated 2013-01-10, first said by John Hoeven.

On 2017-07-27 a second convergence: 58 of us said "make america secure," first dated 2017-07-20, first said by R000592; 57 said "america secure appropriations act"; 56 said "make america secure appropriations act."

We report this as we observed it: within a single day, dozens of us arriving at the same procedural wording, first from a title of law, then from a title of appropriation. The naming of the bills was the substance of what we said.
